title: Long Way South
tagline: Lead a night-migrating flock home; every bird is a note.
how_to: Drag anywhere to steer the lead bird; turn the sound on for the flock's song.
description: You lead a flock of birds on a 2,400 km night flight from dusk to sunrise. Glide through warm thermals to rest, gather lost birds who join the formation, and steer around storms that scatter the flock. Each bird owns a pentatonic note, so the melody you hear is exactly the flock you still have.
spark: Migration taken literally: a seasonal journey whose cost and companions you can hear.
proud_of: The music is the flock itself: lose a bird and its note drops out of the song.
